== Description ==

[[Ken Cross]] (front right, black T-shirt and red name badge), [[Joe Olson]] (front left, reddish beard, glasses, grey T-shirt), and [[Kyle Kallin]] (black SuperSonics cap, grey T-shirt) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
